mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the permission matrix to contain illegal role-operation pairs (e.g., admin accessing RecordRead), which the LeastPrivilege assertion directly checks.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { HospitalAdministrator -> RecordRead in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two distinct notes to share the same note_id, violating the append-only uniqueness constraint that AppendOnly checks.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteDuplicateId { some disj n1, n2: ClinicalNote | n1.note_id = n2.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two audit entries to share the same audit_id, violating immutability.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditDuplicateId { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.audit_id = ae2.audit_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows clinicians to author notes without care-team membership, violating the ownership-based access invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareteamRequired { some note: ClinicalNote | note.author.user_role in ClinicalRole and no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = note.author and ctm.patient = note.patient }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows notes to exist without matching audit entries, violating the always-on audit invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditForNote { some note: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.operation = AddNote and ae.patient = note.patient }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows administrators to author notes or access clinical operations, violating the admin-content-blindness invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminAuthoredNote { some note: ClinicalNote | note.author.user_role = HospitalAdministrator }
